definitions.explanation: The quality of food or drink that sustains health and promotes growth. Often used to describe foods that are particularly nutritious or health-giving.

examples.japanese: {滋養|じよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とる。
⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{滋養|じよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけ⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Build up your strength after being sick.

examples.japanese: うなぎ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{滋養|じよう}{強壮|きょうそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Eel is known as a food that nourishes and invigorates the body.

notes:
{滋養|じよう} has a traditional, somewhat elevated tone compared to the more modern ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {滋養|じよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ — to build up strength through food
- {滋養|じよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ — nourishing, nutritious
- {滋養|じよう}{強壮|きょうそう} — nourishment and invigoration
- {滋養|じよう}⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧ — rich in nutrition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧ — nutrition (modern, scientific; the standard word)
- {滋養|じよう} — nourishment (traditional; suggests health-restoring qualities)

{滋養|じよう}{強壮|きょうそう} is a four-character compound commonly seen on traditional health foods and supplements.
